scientific_integrity: The first posted arXiv source day is 2006-01-12, verified from the archived Dall’Asta preprint; all enumerations and asymptotics are fully derived, and known general 2-periodic criteria are expressly credited. The 2011 manuscript exact first-public day is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Open paths only, with standard nonnegative-degree-threshold synchronous chip-firing.
Period-two orbit counts do not measure basins, transients, or long-period populations.
The closest older general theorem supplies two-cycle inequalities and total-mass interval, not the counted polynomial; possible unindexed prior enumeration remains a risk.
One 1992 source was only available bibliographically, not as full text.
title: The Pell mass law for two-cycles in parallel chip-firing on paths
